data.title: Career
data.body:
Thank you for your interest in United Panel-System (M) Sdn. Bhd. We do not have new positions available currently. When openings arise, they will be posted here.

We welcome enquiries from people who want to grow with Malaysia’s cold storage panel manufacturing industry — feel free to send your CV for future consideration.

data.title: Interested in working with us?
data.body: Send your enquiry or CV to our team — we will follow up when roles are open.
